title: elaphoglossum elegans
intro: Elaphoglossum elegans, commonly known as the Elegant Elaphoglossum, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the division Pteridophyta. Elaphoglossum elegans is valued for its medicinal properties, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antiseptic, making it a potential treatment for various health issues such as hypertension and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
